description: This file is an HTML webpage used for testing or debugging Leaflet map tile layer opacity animation, specifically the 'toner' layer. It sets up a map with two tile layers and dynamically varies the opacity of one layer to create a pulsing effect.

methods.name: setInterval
methods.description: Sets up periodic execution of a function to update tile layer opacity.

methods.name: setOpacity
methods.description: Method of Leaflet tile layer to set the opacity.
